title: Decide input
description: Take one option of an Open or Escalated request. Decide checks every guard and writes no Canon record. Where the option's consequence names a produces kind, the runtime then writes that Canon record, keyed by its record id (the Canon entry carries no request id; two open requests for the same record id must not exist); RecordProduced stores it as produced_record; the run resumes only once produced_record is set. If the case revision moved between Decide and the Canon write, the write is refused and the request is superseded. A crash after Decide leaves a Decided request without produced_record, and the retry writes the Canon record and records it. An option that produces no record resumes or ends the run directly after Decide. A question request may be decided with a free answer in place of an option (both of the operator's trial-2 answers were 'neither option as asked', docs/requester.md § 1); the answer is written to questions.yaml and produces its new revision (artifact_revision).

answer.description: A free answer in place of an option, for a question request only.

sdc.decision.DecisionRequestId.title: DecisionRequestId
sdc.decision.DecisionRequestId.description: Id of a decision request, chosen by the driver: DR-<case>-<action or question id>-<n>.

sdc.decision.OptionLetter.title: OptionLetter
sdc.decision.OptionLetter.description: The letter of an option: A, B, C, in the order presented.

sdc.decision.Principal.title: Principal
sdc.decision.Principal.description: Who decides: a person's name (operator), decider:<kind> (decider:model, decider:approve, decider:reject; decider:haiku in runs before D149), or silence for a default taken because nobody answered. Recorded as given, as Canon records a principal (canon-decisions/1).

sdc.decision.PrincipalKind.title: PrincipalKind
sdc.decision.PrincipalKind.description: person: a named person. decider: decider:<kind>. rule: rule:<name>, a program deciding from evidence (docs/autonomy-levels.md:202-203). silence: the recommended default taken because nobody answered before expires_at (not in autonomy-levels.md; a person-facing addition, A0 to A4 only in practice).
